records.title: Historical police records
records.geographyDescription: Source-defined one-mile radius around the research anchor. This is not an approved town-centre boundary.
limitations: These files contain historical records and published outcome categories, not a complete account of police activity.
Approximate locations cannot confirm that a community report describes the same event.
Crime totals remain unpublished. Source-circle records are not approved pilot totals.

records.title: Transport stations and line status
records.geographyDescription: Hounslow Central Underground Station; Hounslow East Underground Station
limitations: Station details and line status were downloaded at the stated time. This snapshot is not a continuously updated feed.
A line disruption does not establish personal danger.
Transport data use separate TfL terms. Raw records remain internal.

records.title: Transport stop references
records.geographyDescription: Selected official station and interchange access records for the research locations.
limitations: NaPTAN provides static identities. It does not confirm current arrivals, access or staff availability.

records.title: Census population context
records.geographyDescription: Hounslow 018F (E01033083); Hounslow 018 (E02000543); selected through the nearest postcode to the research anchor.
limitations: Census Day: 21 March 2021. These are statistical-area resident counts, not town-centre populations or current footfall.
The nearest-postcode lookup does not prove that the anchor lies inside that statistical area.
LSOA and MSOA totals overlap. Do not add them or use them as pilot crime-rate denominators.

records.title: Police priorities and action updates
records.geographyDescription: Police neighbourhood containing the research anchor; not an approved pilot boundary.
limitations: Police-published priorities are not independent community reports.
Action wording may describe plans, not completed work.
Publication dates do not prove current local conditions.
Published issue/action dates range from 2026-05-05 to 2026-09-04.

records.title: Independent community observations
records.geographyDescription: No genuine recent community dataset has been imported for this pilot.
limitations: The app demonstration reports are fictional. They are not evidence of real incidents.
Police-published priorities are not independent community corroboration.
A permitted public source or consented observation is needed before comparing actual community claims.
